Only one relevant nav item exists: a top-level 'SALE' menu entry currently labelled 'AUTUMN SALE' at https://www.kare.de/c/sale (707 Produkte), with 3 sub-listings Sale Accessoires/Sale Leuchten/Sale Moebel via /c/sale-accessoires, /c/sale-leuchten, /c/sale-moebel. No genuine permanent clearance/outlet/end-of-line listing was found anywhere in navigation, footer, or the checked candidate slugs. This is a correct absence finding, not a failure.
